adverts.featureInfo: Free users see ads throughout the app. Silver and Gold subscribers don't. Upgrade for a faster, ad-free Flightradar24.

history.aircraft.days.featureInfo: Looking for historical aircraft information? See detailed information for past flight numbers or aircraft registrations, including origin, destination, scheduled and actual departure and arrival times.
history.aircraft.days.featureUpgradeInfo: Looking for historical aircraft information? See detailed information for past flight numbers or aircraft registrations, including origin, destination, scheduled and actual departure and arrival times.

history.flight.days.featureInfo: Get info for past flight numbers or aircraft registrations including aircraft type, registration, origin, destination, scheduled and actual flight times. How far back you're able to go depends on your subscription level.
history.flight.days.featureUpgradeInfo: Looking for historical flight information? See detailed information for past flights, including aircraft type, registration, scheduled and actual departure and arrival times.

history.flight.kml.featureInfo: Manual download of CSV/KML files of past flights with flight data including position, speed and altitude. The number of downloads per day is limited by your subscription level. If interested in automated or commercial products, please visit data services for more information.
history.flight.kml.featureUpgradeInfo: Manual download of CSV/KML files of past flights with flight data including position, speed and altitude. The number of downloads per day is limited by your subscription level.

history.playback.days.featureInfo: See what the airspace looked liked at a given time in the past. You can also do playback for an individual flight. How far back you're able to go depends on your subscription level.
history.playback.days.featureUpgradeInfo: See playback of a single flight with detailed flight and aircraft data. Easily jump to any portion of the flight or follow the flight from takeoff to landing.

history.playback.flight.days.featureInfo: See playback of a single flight with detailed flight and aircraft data. Easily jump to any portion of the flight or follow the flight from takeoff to landing.
history.playback.flight.days.featureUpgradeInfo: Visit the past and see a global overview of flights or see detailed playback of a single flight, including altitude and speed graphs.

map.data.ads-b.featureInfo: Real-time positions for ADS-B equipped aircraft. Read more about ADS-B here.

map.data.delaystats.featureInfo: Get an instant overview of the airport delay situation around the world or in a local region.

map.data.faa.featureInfo: Official US/Canada radar data covering North America and certain oceanic regions around North America. Read more about the radar data here.

map.data.flarm.featureInfo: Real-time data from FLARM equipped aircraft. Read more about FLARM here.

map.data.mlat.featureInfo: Real-time positions for non-ADS-B equipped aircraft. Read more about MLAT here.

map.data.satellite.featureInfo: Real-time data from satellite equipped aircraft, such as Solar Impulse 2.

map.filters.saved.featureInfo: You can set filters to narrow down what aircraft should be shown on the map either by category, e.g. Passenger, Cargo and Military or by custom filters, using callsign, airport, altitude, speed, aircraft type and registration. You can use your free filter on airline, aircraft, airport and route filters. The number of filters you are able to save depends on your subscription plan. Access to Categories and Advanced filters is available with a Silver or Gold plan.
map.filters.saved.featureUpgradeInfo: You can set filters to narrow down what aircraft should be shown on the map either by category, e.g. Passenger, Cargo and Military or by custom filters, using callsign, airport, altitude, speed, aircraft type and registration. You can use your free filter on airline, aircraft, airport and route filters. The number of filters you are able to save depends on your subscription plan. Access to Categories and Advanced filters is available with a Silver or Gold plan.

map.info.aircraft.featureInfo: Basic users see aircraft type, registration, and Mode-S code. Silver, Gold, and Business subscribers also see the Manufacturer's Serial Number and aircraft age.
map.info.aircraft.featureUpgradeInfo: Looking for historical aircraft information? See detailed information for past flights, including origin, destination, scheduled and actual departure and arrival times. How far back the aircraft history will go depends on your subscription level.

map.info.aircraft.age.featureInfo: Wondering if an aircraft is brand new or 20 years old? See the age of the aircraft you're tracking and when it first flew.
map.info.aircraft.age.featureUpgradeInfo: Wondering if an aircraft is brand new or 20 years old? See the age of the aircraft you're tracking and when it first flew.

map.info.aircraft.country.featureInfo: See the country of registration for each aircraft on the flight info panel.
map.info.aircraft.country.featureUpgradeInfo: See the country of registration for each aircraft on the flight info panel.

map.info.aircraft.code.featureInfo: A six digit alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the aircraft's transponder

map.info.aircraft.msn.featureInfo: See the aircraft's unique manufacturer's serial number (MSN), which stays the same even when an aircraft's registration changes.
map.info.aircraft.msn.featureUpgradeInfo: See the aircraft's unique manufacturer's serial number (MSN), which stays the same even when an aircraft's registration changes.

map.info.aircraft.registration.featureInfo: A unique identifier of an aircraft, often called a tail number because of where it is printed on the aircraft.

map.info.aircraft.type.featureInfo: The detailed name of the aircraft, including ICAO assigned type code. Use the ICAO type code to create aircraft filters.
map.info.aircraft.type.featureUpgradeInfo: The detailed name of the aircraft, including ICAO assigned type code. Use the ICAO type code to create aircraft filters.

map.info.airport.onground.hours.featureInfo: List of the aircraft that we have tracked landing at a particular airport. An aircraft will remain on the list until we can confirm that it has departed from the airport. How far back the list will go depends on your subscription level.
map.info.airport.onground.hours.featureUpgradeInfo: List of the aircraft that we have tracked landing at a particular airport. An aircraft will remain on the list until we can confirm that it has departed from the airport. How far back the list will go depends on your subscription level.

map.info.flight.featureInfo: Basic users see ground speed, calibrated altitude, track, and position. Silver subscribers see Basic information as well as vertical speed and squawk. Gold and Business subscribers also have access to FIR and UIR information as well as Extended Mode-S data, which can include GPS altitude, wind and temperature information, and additional aircraft speed data.
map.info.flight.featureUpgradeInfo: Looking for historical flight information? See detailed information for past flights, including aircraft type, registration, scheduled and actual departure and arrival times. How far back the flight history will go depends on your subscription level.

map.info.flight.airspace.featureInfo: See which air traffic controllers are currently responsible for a flight thanks to worldwide Flight Information Region (FIR) and Upper Information Region (UIR) data.
map.info.flight.airspace.featureUpgradeInfo: See which air traffic controllers are currently responsible for a flight with worldwide Flight Information Region and Upper Information Region boundaries overlaid on map. The current ATC area for an individual flight is also shown in the flight information box for that flight.

map.info.flight.calibrated-altitude.featureInfo: Corrected Pressure Altitude Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL)
map.info.flight.calibrated-altitude.featureUpgradeInfo: Corrected Pressure Altitude Above Mean Sea Level (AMSL)

map.info.flight.ems.alt.gps.featureInfo: The aircraft's altitude reported by GPS, based on an ellipsoid of the entire earth and not necessarily indicative of altitude above ground.
map.info.flight.ems.alt.gps.featureUpgradeInfo: The aircraft's altitude reported by GPS, based on an ellipsoid of the entire earth and not necessarily indicative of altitude above the ground.

map.info.flight.ems.ias.featureInfo: Indicated airspeed is the speed of the aircraft through the air taken directly from airspeed indicator without any corrections for temperature or pressure.
map.info.flight.ems.ias.featureUpgradeInfo: Indicated airspeed is the speed of the aircraft through the air taken directly from airspeed indicator without any corrections for temperature or pressure.

map.info.flight.ems.mach.featureInfo: A Mach number is the ratio of true airspeed to the speed of sound at the altitude of a given flight.
map.info.flight.ems.mach.featureUpgradeInfo: A Mach number is the ratio of true airspeed to the speed of sound at the altitude of a given flight.

map.info.flight.ems.oat.featureInfo: See the outside air temperature reported directly from the aircraft.
map.info.flight.ems.oat.featureUpgradeInfo: See the outside air temperature reported directly from the aircraft.

map.info.flight.ems.tas.featureInfo: True airspeed is the airspeed of an aircraft corrected for position and instrument error and taking pressure and temperature into account.
map.info.flight.ems.tas.featureUpgradeInfo: True airspeed is the airspeed of an aircraft corrected for position and instrument error and taking pressure and temperature into account.

map.info.flight.ems.wind.featureInfo: See if a flight is flying with the wind or against it. View the wind speed and direction reported directly from the aircraft.
map.info.flight.ems.wind.featureUpgradeInfo: See if a flight is flying with the wind or against it. View the wind speed and direction reported directly from the aircraft.

map.info.flight.position.featureInfo: The location of the aircraft given in latitude and longitude.
map.info.flight.position.featureUpgradeInfo: The location of the aircraft given in latitude and longitude.

map.info.flight.squawk.featureInfo: A four-digit code assigned to a flight by air traffic control to match the flight to its radar screens.
map.info.flight.squawk.featureUpgradeInfo: Squawk code is a four digit code assigned to a flight by aircraft traffic control to match the flight to its radar screens.

map.info.flight.vertical-speed.featureInfo: See how quickly an aircraft is ascending or descending.
map.info.flight.vertical-speed.featureUpgradeInfo: See how quickly an aircraft is ascending or descending.

map.labels.rows.featureInfo: Choose what information travels with the aircraft icons. Add identifiers like callsign, flight number or registration and include additional information like type & registration, altitude & speed or origin & destination. The number of text labels you are able to view depends on your subscription plan.
map.labels.rows.featureUpgradeInfo: Choose what information travels with the aircraft icons. Add identifiers like callsign, flight number, or registration and include additional information like type & registration, altitude & speed, or origin & destination. The number of text labels you are able to view depends on your subscription plan.

map.layer.atc.featureInfo: See which air traffic controllers are currently responsible for a flight with worldwide Flight Information Region (FIR) and Upper Information Region (UIR) boundaries overlaid on map. The current ATC area for an individual flight is also shown in the flight information box for that flight.
map.layer.atc.featureUpgradeInfo: See which air traffic controllers are currently responsible for a flight with worldwide Flight Information Region and Upper Information Region boundaries overlaid on map. The current ATC area for an individual flight is also shown in the flight information box for that flight.

map.layer.ndb.featureInfo: See navigational aids, which are radio beacons that help pilots navigate, overlaid on the map.
map.layer.ndb.featureUpgradeInfo: See navigational aids, which are radio beacons that help pilots navigate, overlaid on the map.

map.layer.ndb.alt.high.featureInfo: See navigational waypoints and airways for high altitude flights overlaid on map.
map.layer.ndb.alt.high.featureUpgradeInfo: See navigational waypoints and airways for high altitude flights overlaid on map.

map.layer.ndb.alt.low.featureInfo: See navigational waypoints and airways for low altitude flights overlaid on map.
map.layer.ndb.alt.low.featureUpgradeInfo: See navigational waypoints and airways for low altitude flights overlaid on map.

map.layer.ndb.charts.featureInfo: To safely arrive at their destination and maintain separation from other flights, aircraft follow airways between navigational waypoints. See a flight’s route with our high and low altitude charts, plus a dedicated layer for navigational aids.
map.layer.ndb.charts.featureUpgradeInfo: To safely arrive at their destination and maintain separation from other flights, aircraft follow airways between navigational waypoints. See a flight’s route with our high and low altitude charts, plus a dedicated layer for navigational aids.

map.layer.tracks.oceanic.featureInfo: Over areas like the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, flights follow organized tracks to stay safely separated when outside contact with air traffic control. The tracks are updated twice daily to take wind and weather into account. View these tracks on our live map and see how flights follow them to safely navigate over open ocean.
map.layer.tracks.oceanic.featureUpgradeInfo: Over areas like the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans, flights follow organized tracks to stay safely separated when outside constant contact with air traffic control. The tracks are updated twice daily to take wind and weather into account. View these tracks on our live map and see how flights follow them to safely navigate over open ocean.

map.layer.weather.featureInfo: Sunny and warm in Madrid, raining and cold in San Francisco. See the current weather, including temperature and sky conditions, for over 3,000 airports worldwide overlaid on our live map.
map.layer.weather.featureUpgradeInfo: Sunny and warm in Madrid, raining and cold in San Francisco. See the current weather, including temperature and sky conditions, for over 3,000 airports worldwide overlaid on our live map.

map.layer.weather.airmet.featureInfo: AIRMETs/SIGMETs issued by authorities forecasting significant weather events that are potentially hazardous to flights, refreshed every 30 min. Click on an AIRMET/SIGMET to see the full text.

map.layer.weather.auradar.featureInfo: Australian radar is a composite image of precipitation throughout Australia at 2 km resolution.
map.layer.weather.auradar.featureUpgradeInfo: Australian radar is a composite image of precipitation throughout Australia at 2 km resolution.

map.layer.weather.cat.featureInfo: Clear-air turbulence is the turbulent movement of air without any visual clues, this can often impact aviation. See clear air turbulence at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.
map.layer.weather.cat.featureUpgradeInfo: Clear-air turbulence is the turbulent movement of air without any visual clues, this can often impact aviation. See clear air turbulence at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.

map.layer.weather.highlevel.featureInfo: Forecasted areas of high level significant weather, such as wind patterns and storm activity, available for up to a 24-hour period in six hour increments.

map.layer.weather.icing.featureInfo: Icing can lead to ice build up on aircraft which can be extremely dangerous for pilots. See forecasted icing at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.
map.layer.weather.icing.featureUpgradeInfo: Icing can lead to ice build up on aircraft which can be extremely dangerous for pilots. See forecasted icing at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.

map.layer.weather.ict.featureInfo: Currents and water vapor in and around clouds can cause turbulence, this can often impact aviation. See in cloud turbulence at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.
map.layer.weather.ict.featureUpgradeInfo: Currents and water vapor in and around clouds can cause turbulence, this can often impact aviation. See in cloud turbulence at various altitudes for a specific time in the future overlayed on our live map.

map.layer.weather.lightning.featureInfo: Recorded lightning strikes shown on the map, updated every 15 minutes.

map.layer.weather.naradar.featureInfo: High-resolution North American Radar is a mosaic image of radars covering the continental US, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the southern portion of Canada. High-resolution North American Radar combines 1 km resolution with frequent updates for the best weather detail and timeliness.
map.layer.weather.naradar.featureUpgradeInfo: High-resolution North American Radar is a mosaic image of radars covering the continental US, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and the southern portion of Canada. High-resolution North American Radar combines 1 km resolution with frequent updates for the best weather detail and timeliness.

map.layer.weather.radar.featureInfo: See the weather flights are avoiding overlaid on our live map. Global Radar provides worldwide areas of intense precipitation so you'll know how much of an impact it could have on flights. The intense precipitation layer is refreshed every 30 minutes.
map.layer.weather.radar.featureUpgradeInfo: See the weather flights are avoiding overlaid on our live map. Global Radar provides worldwide areas of intense precipitation so you'll know how much of an impact it could have on flights. The intense precipitation layer is refreshed every 30 minutes.

map.layer.weather.radar.global.featureInfo: An overview of current global precipitation overlaid on our live map. The total precipitation layer is refreshed 12 times a day.
map.layer.weather.radar.global.featureUpgradeInfo: An overview of current global precipitation overlaid on our live map. The total precipitation layer is refreshed 12 times a day.

map.layer.weather.satellite.featureInfo: Global IR Satellite provides worldwide cloud cover displayed on the map, refreshed every 60 minutes.
map.layer.weather.satellite.featureUpgradeInfo: Global IR Satellite lets you view worldwide cloud cover on our live map, refreshed every 60 minutes.

map.layer.weather.volcano.featureInfo: Volcanic eruptions can have a major impact on aviation (remember Iceland's Eyjafjallajökull?). See which volcanoes are active and the location of any ash clouds affecting flights on our live map.

map.layer.weather.wind.featureInfo: See wind speed and direction on our live map in increments of 1,000 feet from 1,000 to 51,000 feet. Displayed in either wind barbs or a color gradient. The winds layer is refreshed 12 times a day.
map.layer.weather.wind.featureUpgradeInfo: See wind speed and direction on our live map in increments of 1,000 feet from 1,000 to 51,000 feet. Displayed in either wind barbs or a color gradient. The winds layer is refreshed 12 times a day.

map.status.flight.featureInfo: View the flight number, airline, origin, destination, flight schedule, estimated time of arrival, actual time of departure, average flight time, average arrival delay and flight distance.

map.tracking.live.featureInfo: See real-time data from live flights around the world.

map.widgets.bookmarks.max.featureInfo: Create a bookmark to easily access a saved flight, aircraft, airport or map position. The number of available bookmarks depends on your subscription level.
map.widgets.bookmarks.max.featureUpgradeInfo: Create a bookmark to easily access a saved flight, aircraft, airport or map position. The number of available bookmarks depends on your subscription level.

user.alerts.max.featureInfo: Let flights come to you. Create custom alerts for a flight number, registration, airline, or aircraft type and get notified when a flight meets your criteria. The number of custom alerts you can create depends on your subscription level.

map.view.3d.mobile.featureInfo: Follow a 3D model over high-resolution satellite and terrain imagery. Now also see other nearby flights and aircraft shadows. Access three 3D sessions using a free Basic account and get more sessions by watching an ad. Unlimited access to 3D view is available with any paid Flightradar24 subscription.
map.view.3d.mobile.featureUpgradeInfo: 3D view, including unlimited sessions, is available with any Flightradar24 subscription.
